column2: Axial Base - Deep Profiler Mooring: During this dive, ROPOS removed the beacon from the base of the mooring, and reconnected the AXVMW4 cable from the LV03A junction box. ROPOS pulled away and the system was powered on from shore. Communications were established with the docking station, but not with the Deep Profiler. ROPOS transited upward, following the cable and encountered the vehicle at 789 m. The decision was made to attach a carabiner to the profiler to send it down to the docking station. The hope is that through WiFi or ICL, communications can be achieved with the vehicle. ROPOS followed the wire back up and recovered the beacon from the top of the mooring.
